full_judgment: 7. It appears that after the auction, the rest of the bid money was not deposited within the period of 10(ten) days as envisaged under sub-section 2 of section 33 of the Ain. But it is to be noted that the auction of the concerned property of the petitioners was not sold in auction in pursuance of a decree or order as envisaged under section 33 of the Ain but the auction was made prior to filing of the suit in pursuance to sub-section 1 of section 12 of the Ain, as such, under sub-section 4 of section 12, the provisions of section 33 are not mandatory. Besides, it appears that although by an order dated 12-10-2005, the auction purchaser was directed to deposit the rest of the bid money but by an order dated 19-10-2005, passed by the High Court Division in the writ petition, all further actions pursuant to the impugned auction was stayed, as such, the rest of the bid money could not be deposited in time.
